task: structured source-only procedure proposals for stylesheet tools

source_anchors.evidence: inject_stylesheet and remove_stylesheet require css:string with min length 1; optional integer tab_id; use assigned tab when omitted; call chrome.scripting.insertCSS/removeCSS and return {ok:true} or {ok:false,reason}. Both tier privileged.
stylesheet accepts action enum inject|remove, css:string min length 1, optional integer tab_id; delegates to the corresponding leaf handler. No persistent argument exists in live source schema.

Tools tab parses JSON and validates local handler schema, then calls handler.run directly with permissionMode act. Its Run control skips the dispatcher permission gate; UI labels this Test mode bypasses approval. Inline result is handler output, not proof of page appearance.

Normal delegated execution validates schema, checks declared optional permissions, enforces Pilot tab-group scope, then requests confirmation for privileged tools regardless of Ask/Act mode. The stylesheet inventory declares required Chrome permissions activeTab and scripting and no optional permissions.
inject_stylesheet and remove_stylesheet declare activeTab and scripting as required permissions.

Existing native fixture server serves only exact in-memory routes and returns 404 for unknown paths; suitable owned-fixture mechanism, but stylesheet-specific page and current URL are not established by this source.

Preserves feature/case/control IDs, member/admin applicability, guest N/A for Tools UI, and required permission/fixture gates. Its stylesheet input_schema lists persistent although current live canonical source omits it; reconcile before inventory signoff.

procedure_prerequisites.execution: Not performed in this lane. Before each eventual run, acquire the current stabilization resource permit and create a current receipt using docs/stabilization/PLAN.md § Build and reload contract. Include source SHA and dirty-source hash when applicable, lockfile/output hashes, WXT mode, extension runtime ID, Chrome version, profile, auth/role/org, permissions, backend identity, fixture IDs, timestamp, login/provenance/data origin, flags, interception/mocks and seeded state. Never include secrets.
procedure_prerequisites.target: Use only a freshly created or otherwise explicitly owned tab served by the existing exact-route owned fixture server. Record fixture route and tab ID in the run receipt; do not target an unrelated personal tab. No stylesheet-specific fixture route is present in the inspected server source, so prepare/identify that benign route in the execution lane before running.
procedure_prerequisites.fixture_css: For a page with a visible h1, use the same exact CSS string on injection and removal: h1 { color: rgb(190, 24, 93) !important; background-color: rgb(255, 237, 213) !important; }. Capture baseline and post-call visible h1 computed color/background through the page UI/observation. The distinct visual values are a proposed fixture input, not an observed result.
procedure_prerequisites.permission_boundary: Inventory says required permissions activeTab and scripting, required_optional_permissions empty, admin_only false. Record actual granted/effective permissions in receipt. A manual Tools-tab Run can bypass approval and cannot establish dispatcher authorization. For dispatcher path, run only through actual delegated call on the owned tab; privileged approval must be presented and explicitly accepted. Do not infer access or permission denial from guest N/A or from a manual runner result.
procedure_prerequisites.cleanup: Remove only the exact CSS string this run inserted, on the exact owned tab ID; verify baseline appearance returns. If extension/page reload has already unloaded the injected stylesheet, record that boundary and do not claim remove_stylesheet removed it. Close only the owned fixture tab after evidence capture. Never enumerate, remove, or delete any other stylesheet or style record.
procedure_prerequisites.reload: Follow PLAN.md § Build and reload contract: separate extension Reload from target page reload; rebuild/reload only when source/manifest/permissions/config/environment changes require it, verify the runtime build identity, reopen sidepanel and refocus/reload only the owned fixture. Injected CSS is document-scoped in this handler path; treat page reload as a fresh baseline and repeat inject/visual check/owned exact removal rather than expecting persistence.

role_and_dispatcher_limits.guest: Inventory marks these Tools UI cases not applicable because Tools requires sign-in; record N/A for these case IDs. If assessing guest access, use the separate Tools UI negative-access case, not a claim that the handler itself was inaccessible.
role_and_dispatcher_limits.member: Applicable. Run each listed procedure under a signed-in ordinary-member profile. Manual Run proves only the direct user-initiated handler path. Dispatcher confirmation/permission results require the real delegated dispatcher path and must be recorded separately.
role_and_dispatcher_limits.admin: Applicable. Run each listed procedure under signed-in admin profile. Admin success cannot replace the member run. Manual Run remains approval-bypassing even for admin.
role_and_dispatcher_limits.visual_verdict: A returned {ok:true} is API completion only. Require the expected visible h1 style change and restoration as independent observations; no result has been observed in this source-only lane.

cases.name: inject_stylesheet
cases.title: Controlled manual execution: inject_stylesheet
steps: Meet procedure_prerequisites for the selected role; record the current resource permit and receipt. Open the identified owned fixture route in a newly owned tab and record its exact tab ID.

Observe and record the h1 baseline color and background. In Tools, locate inject_stylesheet, enter exactly {"css":"h1 { color: rgb(190, 24, 93) !important; background-color: rgb(255, 237, 213) !important; }","tab_id":<owned-tab-id>} and click Run. The integer placeholder must be replaced by the receipt's actual owned tab ID.
Record inline handler output and separately observe the owned fixture h1. Require the proposed pink text and peach background to be visible before assigning a visual pass.

Run invalid-input checks separately in the same manual runner: empty css, numeric css, string tab_id, and an extra persistent property. Record each schema rejection and verify the fixture appearance did not change.

For dispatcher coverage, separately invoke inject_stylesheet through an actual delegated call on the same owned fixture. Confirm privileged approval appears even when permission mode is Act; deny once and verify no visual change, then accept on a fresh call and verify the visual change. Do not count manual Run as this result.

Reload the owned page and record baseline restoration. If a fresh-build/reload case is required, perform the PLAN.md reload sequence with a new receipt and repeat on this owned tab; do not assert CSS survives document reload.
expected_observations: Valid manual call returns {ok:true}; this alone remains insufficient for visual acceptance.
After valid injection, the owned visible h1 has rgb(190, 24, 93) text and rgb(255, 237, 213) background; after page reload the document returns to its baseline styling.
Invalid values fail schema validation before handler execution and produce no visible style change.
In delegated path, privileged denial yields no effect; explicit approval permits effect. Capture each actual result independently.
negative_cases: unknown persistent property => schema rejection under current source schema; inventory catalog currently disagrees and needs reconciliation.
unowned tab or a tab not authorized by the real delegated/Pilot scope => do not attempt; this is a safety boundary, not a fixture input.

controls_coverage.EXT-F-4125-C01: Invoke inject_stylesheet through the manual runner with controlled valid input; separately distinguish true dispatcher path.

unresolved_dimensions: No stylesheet-specific owned fixture route or URL is recorded; execution owner must identify/prepare one and include its ID in receipt.
The manual runner's direct handler call may not share the dispatcher tab/permission semantics; actual activeTab grant conditions need live observation.
Whether invalid tab_id values fail at schema only or reach Chrome API should be recorded from actual run; the proposed string case checks schema boundary.

cases.name: remove_stylesheet
cases.title: Controlled manual execution: remove_stylesheet
steps: Meet procedure_prerequisites for the selected role and open a new owned fixture tab; record its exact tab ID and baseline h1 appearance.
Establish only this run's stylesheet by invoking inject_stylesheet on the owned tab with the exact fixture_css string; require its distinct visual effect before continuing.

In Tools, locate remove_stylesheet and enter exactly {"css":"h1 { color: rgb(190, 24, 93) !important; background-color: rgb(255, 237, 213) !important; }","tab_id":<owned-tab-id>}; click Run. Record API output and separately observe restoration of the owned h1 baseline.

Repeat from a fresh owned fixture tab for invalid-input cases: empty css, numeric css, string tab_id, and extra persistent property. Verify schema rejection and that no unrelated page/style was touched.

Separately exercise the real delegated path: first inject on this owned tab through the dispatcher with explicit privileged approval; then remove through the dispatcher and explicitly approve. Verify visual restoration. A denied remove attempt must leave the owned injected style visible; then clean it up with the exact approved input.

Reload the owned page only after recording the warm removal result. On reload, expect natural document baseline; do not call that proof of remove_stylesheet. For post-extension-reload coverage, start from a fresh receipt and re-establish this run's own style before removing it.
expected_observations: Precondition injection visibly changes only the owned h1.
Valid remove returns {ok:true} and restores the owned h1's captured baseline appearance.
Invalid input rejects before mutation; denied dispatcher confirmation leaves the owned injected style visible.
Cleanup is scoped to the exact same CSS and owned tab ID; never remove another run's or page's style.
negative_cases: Attempting removal with empty css, numeric css, string tab_id, or extra persistent property must fail schema validation.
Attempting remove before this run injected the exact CSS is excluded from acceptance because it cannot prove removal and may interact with another owner's identical style.

controls_coverage.EXT-F-4126-C01: Invoke remove_stylesheet only after this run has visibly injected the exact CSS on its owned target.

unresolved_dimensions: No fixture route is specified in inventory; prepare/identify a page with visible h1 and bind exact tab ID in receipt.
Chrome removal matching behavior for the exact CSS string and document lifetime is not observed here; preserve exact bytes and record outcome.
Permission and privileged-confirmation behavior must be recorded from the real delegated path independently of manual runner.

cases.name: stylesheet
cases.title: Controlled manual execution: stylesheet
steps: Meet procedure_prerequisites for the selected role, create an owned fixture tab, and capture its exact ID and h1 baseline.

In Tools, locate stylesheet and enter {"action":"inject","css":"h1 { color: rgb(190, 24, 93) !important; background-color: rgb(255, 237, 213) !important; }","tab_id":<owned-tab-id>}. Run, record inline output, and independently confirm the visible h1 changed.

Enter the same action=inject call through the true delegated path on a fresh owned fixture target. Record privileged approval and verify deny causes no effect; on a separate accepted call verify visible effect.

On the same owned target, run {"action":"remove","css":"h1 { color: rgb(190, 24, 93) !important; background-color: rgb(255, 237, 213) !important; }","tab_id":<owned-tab-id>}; require baseline appearance restoration. Repeat the real delegated path with explicit approval, with a denied attempt leaving the owned style in place.
Check invalid inputs one at a time: action=unknown, missing action, empty css, numeric css, string tab_id, and extra persistent property. Record schema rejection and confirm no visible change.

Reload the owned page to establish lifecycle boundary and observe natural baseline. For a fresh extension build/reload pass, verify the receipt-bound runtime, create a fresh owned target or re-establish only this run's style, then repeat both action branches and exact cleanup.
expected_observations: action=inject delegates to insertCSS and yields the same visible style change as the leaf handler.
action=remove delegates to removeCSS and restores the captured baseline for this run's own exact CSS only.
Unknown/missing action or invalid schema values produce no style change.
Manual output alone is not visual acceptance; delegated path approval and permission results are separate evidence.
negative_cases: action=unknown, omitted action, empty css, numeric css, string tab_id, and extra persistent property should be schema-rejected.
The old catalog record advertises persistent, but current live StylesheetArgs has no persistent key; do not submit it as a valid option. Resolve catalog drift before inventory signoff.
Do not use remove branch against a style not created by this run.

controls_coverage.EXT-F-4167-C01: Invoke canonical stylesheet through manual runner and separately dispatcher.
controls_coverage.EXT-F-4167-C02: Action inject visibly changes the owned fixture page.
controls_coverage.EXT-F-4167-C03: Action remove restores the owned fixture baseline after this run's injection.

No stylesheet-specific fixture route or already-minted current build receipt is present in reviewed source; execution remains pending permit and fixture identification.
Actual dispatcher target binding, activeTab grant behavior and UI confirmation must be observed in the signed-in profiles; the Tools runner cannot establish them.
